codex-exec.notes: Prompt on standard input. Final message read from a file. A dead tool host is reported as a failure.

hermes-exec.readTier: Safe mode by default; setting `readMode` to `keep` uses your Hermes settings, skips rules files
hermes-exec.notes: Usage comes from a usage file. Cached reads are added to input.

copilot-exec.notes: Cost is reported in AI credits. Token counts are rounded by the CLI. The prompt is an argument, so it is visible in the process list while the job runs.

claude-exec.harness: Claude Code on the API key
claude-exec.readTier: tools allowlist (Read, Grep, Glob) and permission mode dontAsk
claude-exec.notes: The wrapper reads the API key. Each job has a turn count and dollar cap. Profile context is trimmed unless the route or service keeps it.

grok-exec.readTier: deny rules for Edit and Bash
grok-exec.notes: Prompt read from a file. Not run against the service until the weekly quota resets.

mcode-exec.readTier: Smart permissions and a prompt restriction; writes are allowed
mcode-exec.notes: The adapter works on a copy of the workspace, returns a patch, and has unit tests but no end-to-end run against the service yet. A probe on this computer showed that smart permissions still let the model create a file.

openai-api.notes: Text only. The key is read from the environment variable the route names.

anthropic-api.notes: Text only. Cache tokens are added to input.

fal-api.notes: One video per job, saved in the job folder. The cost is the route's price per second times the length, checked before the job is sent.

exec.notes: Off unless the service config lists it.
